activity.title: Roll the ball
activity.safety: Use a soft ball. Clear hard toys off the floor first.
activity.forAdult: Sample text for testing the layout. Rolling a ball back and forth practises looking, reaching and waiting for a turn. Start close together; move a little further apart when catching gets easy. Say "my turn" and "your turn" as the ball travels.
activity.inClass: Sample text. Sit in a circle. Say a child's name, then roll the ball to that child.
